units.source_text: 几个乳母都是出身高贵、容姿秀美的人，一齐在照管小公子。

en.t: Several wet nurses, all women of noble birth and graceful beauty, were caring for the young lord together.

units.source_text: 源氏召唤她们前来，叮嘱她们应该如何照管。

en.t: Genji summoned them and carefully instructed them on how they should look after him.

units.source_text: 他说：“唉！我已余命无多，这晚生儿定然会长大成人吧。”

en.t: He said, Alas, I have little life left to me, but this child born so late will surely grow to adulthood.

units.source_text: 便抱了他。

en.t: Then he took the child in his arms.

units.source_text: 但见小公子无思无虑地笑着，长得又胖又白，相貌极美。

en.t: He saw the young lord smiling without a care, plump and fair, with an exceptionally beautiful face.

units.source_text: 源氏隐约回忆夕雾幼时模样，觉得相貌和他不像。

en.t: Genji faintly recalled Yugiri as a child and felt that this boy did not resemble him.

units.source_text: 明石女御所生皇子，出于皇家血统，气品自是高贵，但并不特别清秀。

en.t: The prince born to the Akashi Consort had imperial blood and was naturally noble in bearing, but he was not especially delicate or handsome.

units.source_text: 这个薰君的相貌，却是高贵而又艳丽，目光清炯，常带笑容。

en.t: This Lord Kaoru, however, had a face both noble and radiant, with clear bright eyes and a constant hint of a smile.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得非常可爱。

en.t: Genji found him deeply lovable.

units.source_text: 但恐是心有成见之故吧，觉得他非常肖似柏木。

en.t: Yet perhaps because his mind was already biased, he felt that the child looked very much like Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 现在还只初生，目光已经稳定，神色迥异常人，真乃十全十美的相貌。

en.t: Though he was only newly born, his gaze was already steady, his expression far beyond ordinary children, and his appearance truly flawless.

units.source_text: 三公主没有分明看出他肖似柏木，别人更是全不注意，只有源氏一人在心中慨叹：“可怜啊！柏木的命运何其悲惨啊！”

en.t: The Third Princess did not clearly see his resemblance to Kashiwagi, and others noticed nothing at all; only Genji lamented inwardly, Poor Kashiwagi, how tragic his fate was.

units.source_text: 由此推想人世无常之恸，不知不觉地淌下泪来。

en.t: From this he reflected on the sorrow of human impermanence, and before he knew it tears were running down his face.

units.source_text: 但念今日应该忌避不祥，便揩揩眼泪，吟诵白居易“五十八翁方有后，静思堪喜亦堪嗟”之诗。

en.t: But remembering that this day should be kept free of ill omens, he wiped his tears and recited Bai Juyi's poem about a fifty-eight-year-old man finally having an heir, a thought both joyful and sad in quiet reflection.

units.source_text: 源氏比五十八还少十岁，然而心情上已有迟暮之感，不胜悲伤。

en.t: Genji was ten years younger than fifty-eight, yet in spirit he already felt the weight of late age and could not bear his sadness.

units.source_text: 他很想教训这小公子：“慎勿顽愚似汝爷！”

en.t: He longed to admonish the young lord, Do not be stubborn and foolish like your father.

units.source_text: 他想：“侍女之中定有知道此事内情之人，她们还以为我不知道，把我看作白痴呢。”

en.t: He thought, Among the ladies-in-waiting there must be some who know the truth of this affair, and they think I know nothing and take me for a fool.

units.source_text: 心中便觉不快。

en.t: This made him feel bitterly displeased.

units.source_text: 但他又想：“我被看作白痴，咎由自取。

en.t: But then he thought again, If I am taken for a fool, I have only myself to blame.

units.source_text: 我和公主两方比较起来，公主受人奚落更是难受呢。”

en.t: Compared with me, it must be even harder for the Princess to be mocked by others.

units.source_text: 心中虽如此想，脸上并不表露。

en.t: Although he thought this in his heart, he did not let it show on his face.

units.source_text: 小公子天真烂漫地嬉笑，牙牙学语，那眼梢口角异常美丽。

en.t: The young lord laughed in innocent delight and babbled baby words, and the corners of his eyes and mouth were extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 不知内情的人也许不会注意，但在源氏看来毕竟非常肖似柏木。

en.t: Those who did not know the circumstances might not notice, but to Genji he was unmistakably very like Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 他想：“柏木的双亲定在悲叹他没有儿子吧。

en.t: He thought, Kashiwagi's parents must surely be grieving that he left no son.

units.source_text: 岂知他有这个无人知道的罪恶儿子隐藏在这里，无法教祖父母知道呢。

en.t: How could they know that he has this secret child of sin hidden here, with no way for his grandparents to be told.

units.source_text: 这个气度高傲而思虑圆熟的人，由于自心一念之差而毁灭了他的身体！”

en.t: That proud and thoughtful man destroyed himself through one mistaken impulse of the heart.

units.source_text: 他觉得柏木很可怜，便消除了对他憎恨之心，为他流下同情之泪。

en.t: He felt great pity for Kashiwagi, and his hatred of him vanished as he shed tears of sympathy.
